$comment: Project profile for the canon-shipped harness (tools/harness in the sza plugin). Every omitted key keeps the canon default in tools/harness/_profile.ps1: PLAN/ and temp/ roots, the Sxxxx ticket grammar, the thirteen statuses, the release-plan file names. Only what differs from the defaults is written here. Run harness scripts through tools/harness.ps1, never by copying them.
$comment_archive: Closed tickets live in PLAN/DONE/, the spelling StreamsPlayer for Windows uses. REPO-LAYOUT rule 6 names done/ an archive spelling beside archive/, and the harness default stays PLAN/archive, so the spelling is declared here: the archive folder and the spec file pattern that admits it. spec_catalog/archive moves files to a hard-coded archive folder (reported to the canon session), so closed tickets are moved by hand into PLAN/DONE and the journal path is updated with spec_catalog/update -File.
$comment_modules: The three Gradle modules of handoff section 8 phase 2; the directory names were fixed by S0002 (settings.gradle.kts). The lock path rules below follow them.
$comment_probes: The probe gates walk the module source trees (S0002). Every other key keeps the canon default, which is the Timber.d("Sxxxx: ..") form; Timber itself joins the dependencies with the first ported code (S0003), and nothing is instrumented before then.

commands.$comment_statusCommands: This repo carries no ticket-pipeline commands yet, so the release plan prints the harness operator call instead of a slash command.
